ratio_rationale: ICN+T is a pure research congress of the scanning-probe and nanoscience community with an open call, an abstract book and two poster sessions, and no trade-show layer; at a meeting this size nearly everyone in the room presents, which puts it at the high end of chemistry research congresses (CCS National Congress 79%). Judged 80%. Even at 100% the figure (350) is under half the floor, so the ratio choice cannot change the verdict; flex band 224-336.
method: ABSTRACT LADDER: search 1 (English) 'ICN+T International Conference on Nanoscience and Technology 2024 OR 2026 programme abstracts' returned only unrelated/aggregator series (ICNST Kuala Lumpur, ICNNN, Magnus, United Scientific — predatory-aggregator trap per field notes; ICNST is NOT a successor). Zero-search: icnt2024.org and icnt2026.org do not resolve; iuvsta.org 403s; Wayback CDX of iuvsta.org lists only 'event/icnt-2018' for this series. Search 2 (English) '"ICN+T" ... after Brno 2018 next edition' found no later edition. The 2018 programme book (https://icnt2018.org/images/files/PB/ICNT2018-Programme_Book.html) is a FlippingBook with page images only (download/search assets redirect to the home page) — rung 3 not workable without OCR; the sponsorship PDF link returns a 150-byte HTML stub. No edition since Brno 2018 found: the series may be dormant — orchestrator should consider deleting on non-existence rather than size. RUNG 9: search 3 (English) found KONGRES magazine's post-event report, opened: 'Nearly 350 participants' = A3, basis UNSPECIFIED, 2018. ~280 inferred (band 224-336) is far below 800 and the flexed top is far below 900 -> OUT. Language: English (Czech host pages at ceitec.cz opened, no figure).
